name: 79602 · Abilene, TX
findings: ZIP 79602 (Abilene) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79602 (Abilene) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 79602 (Abilene) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
